data.heading: Server Rules
data.subheading: A short, clear set of standards that keeps Vietnam Airlines PTFS professional, safe and welcoming — for members, staff and every airline we partner with.

items.title: Respect first
items.text: No harassment, hate speech, or targeted disrespect — toward members, staff, or other communities.

items.title: Professionalism in flight
items.text: Callsigns, uniforms, and ATC/pilot conduct that reflect a real flag carrier, not a free-for-all.

items.title: One community
items.text: Vietnam Airlines, Pacific Airlines and VASCO members all fly under the same standard of conduct.

items.question: Follow Discord's Terms of Service
items.answer: You must meet Discord's minimum age requirement and follow Discord's own Community Guidelines at all times, in addition to our server rules.

items.question: Respect and courtesy
items.answer: No harassment, discrimination, hate speech, or targeted insults. Disagreements happen — keep them civil, and take heated conversations to DMs rather than public channels.

items.question: No impersonation
items.answer: Do not impersonate staff, other members, real airline employees, or Roblox/Discord staff. Nickname and avatar changes intended to deceive others will result in a warning or removal.

items.question: Keep content appropriate
items.answer: No NSFW, gore, or otherwise inappropriate content in text, images, voice channels, or usernames — server-wide, no exceptions.

items.question: Advertising
items.answer: Do not advertise other servers, Discord invites, or unrelated projects outside of designated channels. Partner and affiliate promotion is handled through the Affiliates program instead.

items.question: Fly under your assigned callsign
items.answer: Use your correct airline callsign and follow published livery/paint standards for the airline you're flying under (Vietnam Airlines, Pacific Airlines, or VASCO).

items.question: No exploiting or cheating
items.answer: Speedhacking, teleport exploits, stat manipulation, or anything that gives an unfair advantage in PTFS is a zero-tolerance offense and results in an immediate ban.

items.question: ATC and pilot conduct
items.answer: Follow ATC instructions when a controller is active. Air Traffic Controllers are expected to stay professional, clear, and fair to every pilot on frequency, regardless of rank.

items.question: Leave of Absence (LOA)
items.answer: Going to be inactive for a while? Post an LOA request in the designated channel rather than going silent — it protects your rank and keeps staff in the loop.

data.heading: How enforcement works
data.body:
Most first-time issues start with a verbal warning from staff. Repeated or serious violations escalate to a formal warning, then a temporary mute/suspension, and finally removal from the server for continued or severe breaches (exploiting, hate speech, and similar zero-tolerance items skip straight to a ban).

Disagree with a decision? Open a **General Support** ticket via the Helpdesk and a senior staff member will review it.

data.heading: Questions about a rule?
data.body: Staff are happy to clarify anything above — open a ticket and we'll get back to you.

data.heading: About Us
data.body:
Vietnam Airlines was founded in 1956 and later established as a state-owned enterprise in April 1989. Vietnam Airlines is headquartered in Long Biên district, Hanoi, with hubs at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi and Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Ho Chi Minh City. The airline flies 117 routes across 19 countries, excluding codeshared services.

Vietnam Airlines is a member of SkyTeam and is the official flag carrier of Vietnam. It was established in February 2, 2024 and was re-established in May 10, 2026.

data.heading: Corporate Identity
data.body: Vietnam Airlines PTFS represents the premier virtual aviation standard within Roblox Pilot Training Flight Simulator. We bridge national pride with technical discipline, transforming casual flight simulation into a structured commercial network alongside our low-cost and regional subsidiaries, Pacific Airlines and VASCO. From rigorous flight deck procedures to coordinated ground handling across six operational divisions, our mission is to uphold the prestige of Vietnam’s flag carrier while fostering a highly professional simulation community.

data.heading: Staff Team
data.body: The Vietnam Airlines PTFS Staff Team serves as the operational backbone of our virtual airline, ensuring that every flight, recruitment cycle, and community event is executed with technical precision. Guided by a clear chain of command, our leadership team oversees daily flight schedules, automated flight board operations, and alliance relations across all six core divisions. Staff members are held to rigorous standards of professionalism and impartiality, fostering a supportive environment for prospective trainees while strictly enforcing server flight rules, standard operating procedures, and overall group safety.

data.heading: Boeing 787 (B787)
data.body: As one of the first B787 operators in South East Asia, the Dreamliner offers comfortable luxury seating for over 300 passengers to ensure the most enjoyable flight. VNA’s B787 fleet now operates flights between airports in Vietnam as well as throughout Europe and North East Asia.

data.heading: About Pacific Airlines
data.body: Operating as the dedicated low-cost subsidiary under the Vietnam Airlines Group in PTFS, Pacific Airlines delivers high-frequency, budget-friendly regional flights across the entire server network. Designed for rapid airport turnarounds and maximum operational efficiency, Pacific Airlines connects key domestic trunks and high-density point-to-point routes under the callsign PACIFIC (IATA: BL / ICAO: PIC). By offering a streamlined low-cost carrier model, the airline allows passengers to access reliable regional transit while earning competitive Lotusmiles credits on every journey.

data.heading: Fleet
data.body: The carrier's active fleet is built entirely around single-aisle reliability, deploying the Airbus A320-200 and Airbus A321-200 across peak-hour regional schedules. Cabin configurations feature high-density single-class Economy layouts designed to maximize passenger throughput during large group operations. Ground crews and flight attendants follow strict turnaround protocols, completing disembarkation, cleaning checks, and departure clearances within streamlined 12-minute windows between gate arrival and pushback clearance.

data.heading: Pacific Airlines Crew
data.body: Flight deck crews operating for Pacific Airlines must hold a valid Single-Aisle Jet Rating (A320 Family) and adhere strictly to server pushback timings and taxi speed caps. All flights are integrated into the server's automated flight logging system, where hosts post schedules using dedicated dispatch commands. Passengers embarking on Pacific Airlines flights earn fifty percent base Lotusmiles tier credit, providing an accessible pathway for budget travelers to advance their loyalty status across the network.

data.heading: VASCO
data.subheading: Serving as the official regional feeder carrier for Vietnam Airlines PTFS, the Vietnam Air Services Company (VASCO) connects main international hubs to short-field island airstrips and remote regional airfields under the callsign VASCO AIR (IATA: 0V / ICAO: VFC). VASCO plays a vital operational role in ensuring that every destination across the PTFS map remains fully accessible, taking over routes where larger commercial narrowbody and widebody jets cannot safely operate.

data.heading: Fleet
data.body: The airline relies primarily on the ATR 72-500 turboprop alongside specialized regional feeder aircraft tailored for Short Take-Off and Landing (STOL) capabilities. Flying into unpaved island strips and narrow runways requires precise airmanship, steep glide slope management, and visual flight rules (VFR) approaches over challenging coastal terrain. Passenger cabins offer an intimate, specialized regional travel environment that highlights regional destinations across the network.

data.heading: VASCO Crew
data.body: Commanding a VASCO aircraft requires pilots to earn a specialized Turboprop Command Endorsement and demonstrate mastery over manual reverse-thrust rollout and precise low-speed throttle control. Hosts schedule VASCO operations using specific flight management commands to route manifest data correctly. Because of the demanding nature of short-field island flying, passengers earn an elevated seventy-five percent base Lotusmiles tier credit on all VASCO sectors, heavily rewarding travelers who fly the network's most complex routes.

There are 3 different tiers of partnerships and each of them has their specific requirements and benefits.

data.heading: VASCO Partnership TIer
data.body: Our entry-level tier for approved, active partners. Perfect for growing communities and small airlines.

data.heading: Requirements
data.body: Requirements for this tier include having a minimum of 75 members, a server age of at least 0.5 months, active flight operations, a structured staff team, consistent activity, high server quality with clear roles and embeds, and strong moderation standards.

data.heading: Benefits
data.body: Benefits grant official recognition with a Partner Role and listing in our partner embeds to boost your visibility, plus full access to our partner flight network and codeshare opportunities to expand your route offerings. Your members gain Fast-Pass access to streamline Direct Entry applications, backed by direct partnership support and strategic promotion for major events to grow your community. Additionally, you receive one free monthly News Ping advertisement along with a 10% discount on all extra paid advertising to increase your reach across our audience.

data.heading: Pacific Airlines Partnership TIer
data.body: An upgraded partnership level for active organizations that regularly work with our community. This could be a promotion for VASCO Partnerships if they meet the promotion guidelines

data.heading: Requirements
data.body: Requirements for this tier include having a minimum of 150 members, a server age of at least 1.5 months, a solid reputation in the PTC community, active flight operations, a fully trained staff team, high server quality, and consistent activity.

data.heading: Benefits
data.body: Benefits elevate your airline's status with higher priority scheduling for codeshare flights, joint event collaborations, and special network opportunities, alongside exclusive Partner Spotlight features to showcase your server. Your team gets early access to major announcements before standard partners to plan joint operations ahead of time. To maximize your recruitment and event visibility, this tier doubles your promotional reach with two free News Ping advertisements per month, an upgraded 15% discount on paid advertising, and all foundational network perks.

data.heading: Official Vietnam Airlines Partnership Tier
data.body: An upgraded partnership level for active organizations that regularly work with our community. This could be a promotion for Pacific Airlines Partnerships if they meet the promotion guidelines. And the highest one.

data.heading: Requirements
data.body: Requirements for this tier include having a minimum of 300 members, a server age of at least 2.5 months, a fully trained staff team of at least 20 members, a solid PTC community reputation, active operations, a conflict-free record with our staff, and full willingness to cooperate.

data.heading: Benefits
data.body: Benefits deliver our highest level of integration, granting top-tier priority for all eligible flights, major projects, and joint events, along with priority Fast-Pass processing to fast-track your members into our ranks. You receive custom promotional support tailored specifically to your server's major milestones, paired with direct leadership collaboration to work alongside our executive team on joint initiatives. Finally, you gain maximum promotional firepower with three free News Ping advertisements every month and an exclusive 25% discount on all additional paid ads.

items.title: Singapore Airlines
items.text: Welcome aboard Singapore Airlines. We invite you to step onboard and luxuriate in our warm and impeccable service, and discover a journey that’s every bit as delightful as the destination itself. With some of the most comfortable and spacious aircraft in the world, we fly to over 130 destinations around the globe, bringing you closer to the people and places you care the most. Explore the world with us, and experience a journey unlike any other with Singapore Airlines.

items.title: American Airlines
items.text: From the A321neo to the 787-9, we operate a modern fleet designed for efficiency, comfort, and global reach. A signature silver livery reflects both heritage and innovation, while a focus on seamless travel, rewarding loyalty, and strong partnerships keeps us moving forward. The journey is always evolving, and so are we.

items.title: TUI Airways
items.text: TUI Airways is the world's largest charter airline and the UK's fourth-largest carrier. Dedicated to connecting holidaymakers directly to their destinations from 19 regional UK airports, we operate a highly optimised, dual cabin fleet of 60 modern Boeing aircraft. This fleet includes the B737 MAX jets for medium haul flights.

items.title: Jet2
items.text: Founded in 2003 by Jet2plc, Jet2 became the 3rd largest UK leisure airline, connecting to 75+ destinations, from 14 UK airports. Headquartered in Leeds Bradford Airport, Jet2 grew to become the most iconic airline for package holidays, and full guarantee.

items.title: Qatar Airways
items.text: Qatar Airways, based in Doha, delivers award-winning luxury to more than 160 destinations worldwide. With a modern fleet including the Airbus A350, Boeing 777, and Boeing 787 Dreamliner, every journey blends innovation, comfort, and refined Arabian hospitality. Proudly named the 2024 Skytrax Airline of the Year, Qatar Airways sets the standard for global travel.

items.title: ATC24 Academy
items.text: This server was founded on April 3rd, 2025, by @Goof to support future ATC 24 controllers & Pilots. ATC24academy offers intensive training for our students with a wide range of phraseologies for controllers. .

items.title: SAS - Scandinavian Airlines
items.text: Defined by clarity, efficiency, and understated elegance, Scandinavian Airlines reflects the values of the Nordic region — where simplicity is refined, and functionality becomes a form of luxury. Every journey is shaped by a philosophy that prioritizes balance, precision, and a calm, seamless travel experience.

items.title: Air France
items.text: Since it was founded in 1933, Air France has offered its passengers a unique experience on board its aircraft, which serve a vast network worldwide. Structured around three main activities - passenger transport, cargo and aircraft maintenance - Air France has become a major player in the airline industry. In 2004, Air France and KLM Royal Dutch Airlines have formed the Air France-KLM Group, which was soon joined by Transavia. The combination of their strengths makes it the leading group in terms of intercontinental traffic from Europe.

items.title: KLM
items.text: KLM | Royal Dutch Airlines, being founded in 1919 and headquartered at Netherlands is considered one of the world's oldest airlines that are still operating well. Known for their exceptional service and numerous compliments from the community, KLM is considered one of the best and oldest airline in the world. Welkom aan boord.
